title: How Gallium made 4 engineering hires in 15 days with Contrario
summary: With a small team and an ambitious roadmap, Gallium needed not only great engineers, but ones willing to take an early bet on them.
body_markdown:
Gallium is building the first AI-native operating system for marketing. The platform combines specialized AI models with human content engineers to help companies own their category narrative across LinkedIn, X, SEO, and AI Search.


Gallium believes that the companies that win will be the ones who own the narrative of their category consistently and at scale.


Delivering on that vision required an engineering team with the technical depth to build AI systems in production and the ability to move at the pace an early-stage startup demanded.
